title: Not Built For This #4: Unbuilding the Terrace

sentences.en: This is episode four of Not Built For This, Unbuilding the Terrace.
sentences.zh: 这是《Not Built For This》的第四集，主题是“拆解露台社区”。

sentences.en: Lake Charles, Louisiana is a low-lying city in the southwest corner of a low-lying state.
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那州的查尔斯湖市，是一座位于低洼州西南角的低洼城市。

sentences.en: It's right off I-10, about halfway between Baton Rouge and Houston.
sentences.zh: 它紧邻10号州际公路，大约位于巴吞鲁日和休斯敦的中间位置。

sentences.en: And when I first pulled into town, the city was bigger than I was expecting.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次开车进城时，这座城市比我预想的要大。

sentences.en: It was nighttime, and from a distance, the skyline was lit up like some giant metropolis.
sentences.zh: 当时是晚上，从远处看，天际线灯火通明，就像某个巨大的大都市。

sentences.en: It's like a gleaming city.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像一座闪闪发光的城市。

sentences.en: If you looked quickly, you might think you were looking at Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 如果你匆匆一瞥，可能会以为自己看到的是曼哈顿。

sentences.en: But when you get a little closer, you realize those aren't skyscrapers lighting up the night.
sentences.zh: 但当你走近一点，就会发现照亮夜空的并不是摩天大楼。

sentences.en: It's just nothing but fossil fuel infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 那全是化石燃料基础设施。

sentences.en: It's just a series of refineries with lights all up and down the spires of these smokestacks.
sentences.zh: 那只是一连串的炼油厂，烟囱的尖顶上上下下都亮着灯。

sentences.en: It's pretty dramatic.
sentences.zh: 景象相当震撼。

sentences.en: Lake Charles is a city built among petrochemical plants.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯湖是一座建在石油化工工厂之中的城市。

sentences.en: It's sometimes hard to tell where a neighborhood ends and a refinery begins.
sentences.zh: 有时很难分辨哪里是居民区，哪里是炼油厂。

sentences.en: Oil and gas companies are some of the largest employers in town.
sentences.zh: 石油和天然气公司是城里最大的雇主之一。

sentences.en: But you don't have to work in the industry to feel its effects.
sentences.zh: 但你不需要在这一行工作也能感受到它的影响。

sentences.en: The spills and the fires and the high cancer rates.
sentences.zh: 泄漏事故、火灾以及居高不下的癌症发病率。

sentences.en: A lot of the gas that comes through this city gets exported and burned overseas.
sentences.zh: 流经这座城市的许多天然气都被出口并运往海外燃烧了。

sentences.en: But the impacts on the climate are felt right back here in southwest Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 但气候影响却直接回到了路易斯安那州西南部。

sentences.en: Lake Charles is trying to recover from back-to-back hurricanes.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯湖正试图从接连不断的飓风中恢复过来。

sentences.en: In recent years, Lake Charles has been hit with more big storms than just about any city in the country.
sentences.zh: 近年来，查尔斯湖遭受的大型风暴袭击比全国任何城市都要多。

sentences.en: Well, here's a moniker no one wants.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可是一个没人想要的绰号。

sentences.en: America's most weather-battered city.
sentences.zh: “美国最饱受天气摧残的城市”。

sentences.en: Yet, it belongs to Lake Charles, Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个称号属于路易斯安那州的查尔斯湖。

sentences.en: Even though we know intellectually that the burning of fossil fuels is making the weather more dangerous,
sentences.zh: 尽管我们在理智上知道，燃烧化石燃料正在让天气变得更加危险，

sentences.en: it can be hard to really see that connection in our day-to-day lives.
sentences.zh: 但在日常生活中，很难真正看到这种联系。

sentences.en: But you can't miss it in Lake Charles.
sentences.zh: 但在查尔斯湖，你无法忽视它。

sentences.en: The causes and the effects of climate change are on full display.
sentences.zh: 气候变化的原因和后果在这里展现得淋漓尽致。

sentences.en: When I visited, the tallest skyscraper downtown was completely abandoned.
sentences.zh: 我访问时，市中心最高的摩天大楼已经完全废弃了。

sentences.en: Windows blown out by a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 窗户被飓风震碎了。

sentences.en: And in the distance, you could see that ominous petrochemical skyline with smoke trailing into the sky.
sentences.zh: 在远处，你可以看到那令人不安的石化天际线，烟雾拖着长尾飘向天空。

sentences.en: Of all the storm-battered neighborhoods in this storm-battered city,
sentences.zh: 在这座饱受风暴摧残的城市里，所有受灾的社区中，

sentences.en: there's one in particular that I'm here to see.
sentences.zh: 有一个我特别想去看看。

sentences.en: It's called Greenwich Terrace.
sentences.zh: 它叫格林威治露台（Greenwich Terrace）。

sentences.en: It's a mostly black neighborhood, with wide suburban streets and modest single-story homes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个以黑人为主的社区，街道宽阔，有着朴素的单层住宅。

sentences.en: So I'm here in Greenwich Terrace and I'm standing under a tree.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在格林威治露台，站在一棵树下。

sentences.en: I try to keep cool.
sentences.zh: 我试着让自己凉快点。

sentences.en: I huddled in the shade of a tree and watched as a tiny bulldozer chomped away at some concrete.
sentences.zh: 我蜷缩在树荫下，看着一台小型推土机正在啃食着一些混凝土。

sentences.en: This is the sound of a bobcat that is tearing up what's left of the house.
sentences.zh: 这是山猫滑移装载机正在拆除房屋残骸的声音。

sentences.en: All around me were the footprints of homes that no longer exist,
sentences.zh: 我周围都是那些不复存在的房屋留下的痕迹，

sentences.en: with breaks in the sidewalk where the driveways used to be.
sentences.zh: 人行道上留下了曾经是车道的缺口。

sentences.en: Yeah, just a lot of empty, empty land.
sentences.zh: 是的，只剩下大片大片的空地。

sentences.en: These houses weren't ripped up to make way for some big infrastructure project or a new development.
sentences.zh: 这些房子被拆除并不是为了给大型基础设施项目或新开发项目腾地方。

sentences.en: The terrace has flooded so many times in recent years that the government decided to do something dramatic.
sentences.zh: 近年来，露台社区被淹了太多次，政府决定采取激进的措施。

sentences.en: They decided to tear down the houses and pay people to move to higher ground.
sentences.zh: 他们决定拆除房屋，并出钱让居民搬到地势更高的地方。

sentences.en: Here is a sign that says,
sentences.zh: 这里有个牌子写着，

sentences.en: Throughout the country, thousands of people are living in locations that regularly flood.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地，成千上万的人生活在经常被洪水淹没的地方。

sentences.en: And we'll only get more flood-prone as the climate continues to change.
sentences.zh: 随着气候持续变化，我们将面临更多的洪水威胁。

sentences.en: Many of the people who live in these danger zones are caught in this demoralizing loop,
sentences.zh: 许多生活在这些危险区域的人陷入了一个令人沮丧的循环，

sentences.en: flooding and rebuilding over and over again,
sentences.zh: 一次又一次地被淹，一次又一次地重建，

sentences.en: and praying each time that the pattern doesn't repeat.
sentences.zh: 并且每次都在祈祷这种模式不会重演。

sentences.en: But in places like the Greenwich Terrace, the government is trying to break that cycle.
sentences.zh: 但在像格林威治露台这样的地方，政府正试图打破这个循环。

sentences.en: They're giving up on the idea of rebuilding altogether,
sentences.zh: 他们彻底放弃了重建的想法，

sentences.en: and instead trying to help residents move out of harm's way.
sentences.zh: 转而试图帮助居民搬离危险地带。

sentences.en: It sounds simple on paper, but in practice, it's often messy and painful.
sentences.zh: 这在纸面上听起来很简单，但在实践中，往往既混乱又痛苦。

sentences.en: And so today, we're going to follow the process of unbuilding a flood-prone neighborhood
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我们将通过一位居民的视角，

sentences.en: through the eyes of one resident.
sentences.zh: 来追踪拆除一个易受洪水影响社区的过程。

sentences.en: We'll see what it's like to watch the place that you live become unlivable,
sentences.zh: 我们将看到，眼睁睁看着自己居住的地方变得无法居住是什么感觉，

sentences.en: to fight like hell for some help.
sentences.zh: 为了寻求帮助而拼命抗争是什么感觉。

sentences.en: But when help shows up, it comes in the form of an offer to leave the place you love.
sentences.zh: 但当援助到来时，它却是一份让你离开所爱之地的提议。

sentences.en: Because the Greenwich Terrace was just not built for this.
sentences.zh: 因为格林威治露台根本就不是为这种气候而建的。

sentences.en: I'm Emmett Fitzgerald.
sentences.zh: 我是埃米特·菲茨杰拉德（Emmett Fitzgerald）。

sentences.en: I'm standing in your old driveway.
sentences.zh: 我正站在你以前的车道上。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这儿。

sentences.en: This is my driveway.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的车道。

sentences.en: I'm here for 20-plus years.
sentences.zh: 我在这里住了二十多年了。

sentences.en: I'm standing with Trameka Rankins on the empty plot of land where her house used to be.
sentences.zh: 我正和特拉梅卡·兰金斯（Trameka Rankins）站在她曾经的房子所在的空地上。

sentences.en: The only thing left from Trameka's old life is a big old pine tree,
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡旧生活中唯一留下的东西是一棵又大又老的松树，

sentences.en: which she never cared for anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正她从来都不喜欢它。

sentences.en: Don't miss my pine tree, because it puts sap during the wintertime and everything on the core.
sentences.zh: 我可一点都不想念我的松树，因为它在冬天会滴树液，弄得到处都是。

sentences.en: She may not miss her pine tree, but she does miss this place.
sentences.zh: 她可能不会想念她的松树，但她确实想念这个地方。

sentences.en: It's bittersweet coming back here now just to see all the houses that are gone,
sentences.zh: 现在回到这里，看着所有的房子都消失了，感觉真是苦乐参半，

sentences.en: because this whole row were all homes.
sentences.zh: 因为这一整排曾经全是家。

sentences.en: Trameka moved to Lake Charles when she was in high school.
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡上高中的时候搬到了查尔斯湖。

sentences.en: She got married here, had kids, and eventually started looking for a home to buy.
sentences.zh: 她在这里结婚、生子，最终开始寻找买房的机会。

sentences.en: And she found a house she could afford in the Greenwich Terrace.
sentences.zh: 她在格林威治露台找到了一套她买得起的房子。

sentences.en: Nice little house, nice little neighborhood, older people.
sentences.zh: 不错的小房子，不错的小社区，住着一些老年人。

sentences.en: Hey, great, cool.
sentences.zh: 嘿，太棒了，很酷。

sentences.en: She had initially thought of the house as a starter home,
sentences.zh: 她最初把这房子当作过渡房，

sentences.en: a stepping stone on a journey to something bigger and better.
sentences.zh: 作为通往更大更好生活的一个垫脚石。

sentences.en: But life got in the way, and they ended up spending over two decades in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 但生活总有变数，他们最终在露台社区住了二十多年。

sentences.en: And it was a good place to raise kids.
sentences.zh: 这里确实是个养育孩子的好地方。

sentences.en: They had neighbors who looked after each other and also knew how to have a good time.
sentences.zh: 邻居们互相照应，也知道如何享受生活。

sentences.en: And I used to at least wake up on a Saturday morning to somebody going down the neighborhood
sentences.zh: 我过去至少会在周六早上醒来时，听到有人开车经过社区，

sentences.en: with their chorus, music booming.
sentences.zh: 音乐声震天响。

sentences.en: You hear somebody in the neighborhood fussing.
sentences.zh: 你会听到邻居里有人在吵架。

sentences.en: You hear, you know, you smell the barbecue going, or somebody fixing on a car.
sentences.zh: 你会闻到烧烤的味道，或者看到有人在修车。

sentences.en: She says the terrace was full of funny characters, like her next-door neighbor.
sentences.zh: 她说露台社区里充满了有趣的人物，比如她的隔壁邻居。

sentences.en: He meant well, but he kept the neighborhood ready.
sentences.zh: 他本意是好的，但他总是让社区不得安宁。

sentences.en: Any time he'd step out of the house, you know, he was about to do something fishing he wasn't supposed to.
sentences.zh: 每次他走出家门，你知道，他准是要去干些不该干的勾当。

sentences.en: There was a lot of colorful activities that may have happened in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 社区里发生过很多五花八门的事情。

sentences.en: The terrace wasn't Trameka's dream, but it worked for her, at least until 2017.
sentences.zh: 露台社区并不是特拉梅卡的梦想之地，但它确实适合她，至少在2017年之前是这样。

sentences.en: That's when Lake Charles got hit with the first in what would be a string of devastating storMs.
sentences.zh: 那时，查尔斯湖遭遇了后来一系列毁灭性风暴中的第一场。

sentences.en: Hurricane Harvey barreling into the Texas coastline.
sentences.zh: 飓风“哈维”直扑德克萨斯州海岸线。

sentences.en: That could render some areas uninhabitable for months.
sentences.zh: 那场风暴可能导致一些地区数月无法居住。

sentences.en: Hurricane Harvey overwhelmed a drainage canal in the back of the terrace called the Cuyucci Cooley
sentences.zh: 飓风“哈维”淹没了露台社区后面一条名为Cuyucci Cooley的排水渠，

sentences.en: and flooded the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 导致社区被淹。

sentences.en: Trameka was shocked.
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡惊呆了。

sentences.en: I've been here for, you know, 17, 18 years.
sentences.zh: 我在这里住了，你知道，17、18年了。

sentences.en: Nothing ever happened.
sentences.zh: 从来没出过什么事。

sentences.en: So maybe it was a fluke.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这只是个意外。

sentences.en: Maybe it was a lot of rain that we just could not soak up.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为雨下得太大，我们无法吸收。

sentences.en: She made repairs, but now she was worried.
sentences.zh: 她进行了维修，但现在她很担心。

sentences.en: The drainage infrastructure in the terrace couldn't handle Harvey.
sentences.zh: 露台社区的排水基础设施无法应对“哈维”级别的风暴。

sentences.en: It's going to happen again.
sentences.zh: 它还会再发生的。

sentences.en: When?
sentences.zh: 什么时候？

sentences.en: We don't know, but it will.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道，但它一定会发生。

sentences.en: So fast forward to 2020.
sentences.zh: 快进到2020年。

sentences.en: Hurricane Laura came through and demolished the city.
sentences.zh: 飓风“劳拉”席卷而来，摧毁了这座城市。

sentences.en: One of the strongest storms to ever hit the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是有史以来袭击美国的最强风暴之一，

sentences.en: left its mark on just about every part of Lake Charles.
sentences.zh: 在查尔斯湖的几乎每个角落都留下了它的痕迹。

sentences.en: This second hurricane, Hurricane Laura, displaced thousands of people throughout Lake Charles.
sentences.zh: 这第二场飓风，“劳拉”，导致查尔斯湖各地成千上万的人流离失所。

sentences.en: The 150 mile an hour winds knocked a tree into the back of Trameka's house, but the terrace stayed dry.
sentences.zh: 每小时150英里的风速把一棵树吹进了特拉梅卡房子的后部，但露台社区保持了干燥。

sentences.en: I don't know if you can call that luck, but whatever it was, it didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算不算幸运，但无论是什么，它都没能持续太久。

sentences.en: Just a few weeks after Laura had came in August, six, maybe six weeks later, here comes Delta.
sentences.zh: 就在“劳拉”在八月过后没几周，大概六周后，飓风“德尔塔”来了。

sentences.en: Before the city of Lake Charles could even attempt to get back on its feet, another hurricane started bearing down on southwest Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 在查尔斯湖市还没来得及站稳脚跟之前，另一场飓风就开始向路易斯安那州西南部袭来。

sentences.en: This time, Hurricane Delta.
sentences.zh: 这次是飓风“德尔塔”。

sentences.en: It's hard to believe that it's happening again.
sentences.zh: 很难相信这种事又发生了。

sentences.en: Another hurricane.
sentences.zh: 又一场飓风。

sentences.en: Trameka and her family evacuated to Houston.
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡和她的家人撤离到了休斯敦。

sentences.en: They waited out the storm at a hotel.
sentences.zh: 他们在酒店里躲避风暴。

sentences.en: But when they got back home, it was obvious what had happened.
sentences.zh: 但当他们回到家时，显而易见发生了什么。

sentences.en: There were worms at the bottom of the bathtub, lizards inside the house, and the whole place smelled awful.
sentences.zh: 浴缸底部有虫子，屋里有蜥蜴，整个地方闻起来臭气熏天。

sentences.en: I remember my two-year-old grandson looking at me and he's coming outside and he's just shaking his head.
sentences.zh: 我记得我两岁的孙子看着我，他走到外面，只是不停地摇头。

sentences.en: I'm like, what's wrong, baby?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么了，宝贝？

sentences.en: He said, again?
sentences.zh: 他说，又来了？

sentences.en: Again, mama?
sentences.zh: 又来了，妈妈？

sentences.en: Again?
sentences.zh: 又来了？

sentences.en: I was like, unfortunately, baby.
sentences.zh: 我说，不幸的是，宝贝。

sentences.en: Again?
sentences.zh: 又来了？

sentences.en: The family was back to square one.
sentences.zh: 一家人又回到了原点。

sentences.en: They needed to gut the house and rebuild all over again.
sentences.zh: 他们需要清理房屋，重新开始一切。

sentences.en: Trameka had tried to get flood insurance after Harvey, but there'd been a mix-up.
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡在“哈维”之后试图购买洪水保险，但出了点差错。

sentences.en: And so they had to pay for everything out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不得不自掏腰包支付一切费用。

sentences.en: Still, she says that her family was lucky to be able to make repairs at all.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她说她的家人能进行维修已经很幸运了。

sentences.en: Many of the older folks in the neighborhood who were living on fixed incomes just didn't have the resources.
sentences.zh: 社区里许多靠固定收入生活的老年人根本没有资源。

sentences.en: You know, it broke my heart after Delta.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在“德尔塔”之后，我的心都碎了。

sentences.en: You know, I was repairing everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时正在修理一切。

sentences.en: Doing what I had to do.
sentences.zh: 做我必须做的事。

sentences.en: But I watched the older lady open up her door, her screen door, raise up her windows, kept the same curtains in her house, but she tied them up for it to get on sunlight.
sentences.zh: 但我看着那位老太太打开她的门，她的纱门，推开窗户，屋里挂着同样的窗帘，但她把它们系起来让阳光照进来。

sentences.en: She's taking a squeegee and squeezing the water out of her home, and she couldn't do nothing else.
sentences.zh: 她拿着刮水板把家里的水刮出去，她什么也做不了。

sentences.en: You can still see evidence of these hurricanes in Lake Charles today, and the uneven way that different neighborhoods were able to bounce back.
sentences.zh: 今天在查尔斯湖，你仍然可以看到这些飓风的痕迹，以及不同社区在恢复能力上的不平等。

sentences.en: In a federally recognized disaster like Hurricane Delta, FEMA will provide direct relief to survivors.
sentences.zh: 在像飓风“德尔塔”这样的联邦认可的灾难中，联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）会向幸存者提供直接救济。

sentences.en: But it's often slow to arrive and insufficient when it finally does.
sentences.zh: 但它往往姗姗来迟，而且最终到手时也杯水车薪。

sentences.en: And over the years, FEMA has been widely criticized for giving more relief to white people than it does to people of color.
sentences.zh: 多年来，FEMA因向白人提供的救济多于有色人种而受到广泛批评。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, people in wealthier neighborhoods are also more likely to have insurance or just be able to pay for rebuilding out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，较富裕社区的人们也更有可能拥有保险，或者仅仅是有能力自掏腰包进行重建。

sentences.en: The end result of all that is that when you drive around the wealthier, often whiter neighborhoods in South Lake Charles today,
sentences.zh: 这一切的最终结果是，当你今天开车经过南查尔斯湖那些较富裕、通常是白人居住的社区时，

sentences.en: you would have no idea that these hurricanes even happened.
sentences.zh: 你根本不会知道这些飓风曾经发生过。

sentences.en: But in the mostly black, working-class neighborhoods in North Lake Charles, it's a very different story.
sentences.zh: 但在北查尔斯湖那些以黑人为主的工人阶级社区，情况则完全不同。

sentences.en: You know, there's a, there's, I just passed three houses with blue tarps, four houses right there with blue tarps still on their roof.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我刚刚经过三栋盖着蓝色防水布的房子，那边还有四栋房子，屋顶上依然盖着蓝色防水布。

sentences.en: There are still so many blue tarps where a roof should be.
sentences.zh: 在原本应该是屋顶的地方，还有太多的蓝色防水布。

sentences.en: It looks like the hurricanes happened months ago, not years.
sentences.zh: 看起来飓风就像是几个月前发生的，而不是几年前。

sentences.en: We're talking, you know, upwards of two, two, three years ago at this point.
sentences.zh: 我们现在谈论的，你知道，已经是两三年前的事了。

sentences.en: You know, you can really see a lot of, a lot of damage still from the storm, or storms really, like a lot of houses that still don't feel like they've been fully rebuilt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你依然能从那场风暴，或者说那些风暴中看到很多破坏痕迹，很多房子感觉还没完全重建好。

sentences.en: Many of the people who were displaced in these storms still haven't returned home.
sentences.zh: 许多在这些风暴中流离失所的人至今还没能回到家。

sentences.en: According to data from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据美国邮政署的数据，

sentences.en: Postal Service, between 2019 and 2020, Lake Charles lost more of its population to out-migration than any other city in the country.
sentences.zh: 在2019年到2020年间，查尔斯湖市因人口外迁而流失的人口数量居全国之首。

sentences.en: Back at the terrace, as the waters receded and the repairs began,
sentences.zh: 回到特勒斯社区，随着洪水退去，修复工作开始，

sentences.en: two very different stories started to emerge about why this neighborhood in particular seemed to be so vulnerable to flooding.
sentences.zh: 关于为什么这个社区特别容易遭受洪水侵袭，出现了两种截然不同的说法。

sentences.en: The first story, from the local government's perspective, was that the flooding situation was caused by a devilish mix of overlapping problems, including climate change.
sentences.zh: 第一种说法来自地方政府，他们认为洪水是由一系列相互交织的问题共同导致的，其中包括气候变化。

sentences.en: You're certainly seeing things that have never happened before.
sentences.zh: 你确实正在目睹一些前所未有的事情。

sentences.en: Jennifer Cobian is the grants director for Calcasieu Parish, where Lake Charles is located.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·科比安是查尔斯湖所在的卡尔克苏堂区的拨款主管。

sentences.en: She grew up in southwest Louisiana, so she's used to big storMs.
sentences.zh: 她在路易斯安那州西南部长大，所以对大风暴习以为常。

sentences.en: But the pileup of disasters in recent years was eyebrow-raising.
sentences.zh: 但近年来灾难的接连发生还是让她感到震惊。

sentences.en: We were certainly thinking, um, this doesn't feel right.
sentences.zh: 我们当时确实在想，嗯，这感觉不对劲。

sentences.en: For it to be back-to-back like that, that's the red flag, the indicator of this feels a little different.
sentences.zh: 像这样接二连三地发生，这就是危险信号，预示着情况有些不同了。

sentences.en: As wild as this sounds, Jennifer actually thinks that Lake Charles has been lucky not to get hit with an even bigger storm in the last few years.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能很疯狂，但詹妮弗实际上认为，查尔斯湖在过去几年里没遭遇更大的风暴，已经算是幸运了。

sentences.en: We did not see the major catastrophic rain that our neighbors just to the east of us in southeast Louisiana saw,
sentences.zh: 我们没有经历我们东边路易斯安那州东南部邻居们所遭遇的那种灾难性降雨，

sentences.en: and then the 50 inches of rain that just to the west of us in east Texas saw with Hurricane Harvey.
sentences.zh: 也没有经历我们西边东德克萨斯州在哈维飓风期间所遭遇的50英寸降雨。

sentences.en: Which is a crazy thing to think about a city that's been through as much as you have, that there's something worse coming.
sentences.zh: 对于一个已经历经磨难的城市来说，想到未来还会有更糟糕的事情发生，这真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Something else out there.
sentences.zh: 还有其他未知的威胁。

sentences.en: Jennifer says that these supercharged storms are particularly problematic for Lake Charles because the city is so low-lying.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说，这些超强风暴对查尔斯湖来说尤其成问题，因为这座城市地势非常低洼。

sentences.en: And although Lake Charles is about 30 miles from the coast, it sits along the Calcasieu River, a tidal waterway that is rising with the seas.
sentences.zh: 虽然查尔斯湖距离海岸约30英里，但它位于卡尔克苏河沿岸，这是一条随着海平面上升而上涨的潮汐水道。

sentences.en: And so, when there's a big hurricane in the Gulf of Mexico, the storm surge pushes a whole bunch of water all the way up the river to Lake Charles,
sentences.zh: 因此，当墨西哥湾出现大飓风时，风暴潮会将大量海水一路推向查尔斯湖，

sentences.en: which makes it harder for the city to drain.
sentences.zh: 这使得城市更难排水。

sentences.en: It basically acts like a little stopper to all of our waterways.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就像是我们所有水道的一个小塞子。

sentences.en: When you add rain events, especially historical torrential rain events, on top of that, there's nowhere for the water to go.
sentences.zh: 当你再加上降雨事件，尤其是历史性的特大暴雨时，水就无处可去了。

sentences.en: It spills out of the bayous and the coolies and into the city, where it starts to pool in the lowest-lying spots.
sentences.zh: 它从河口和沟渠中溢出，涌入城市，开始在最低洼的地方积聚。

sentences.en: So, this is the Greenwich Terrace neighborhood right here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是格林威治特勒斯社区。

sentences.en: Jennifer pulls up a map of Lake Charles on her computer.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗在电脑上调出了查尔斯湖的地图。

sentences.en: It shows the ground surface elevation throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 它显示了整个城市的地表海拔。

sentences.en: Higher elevations are red, and the lower elevations are blue.
sentences.zh: 海拔较高的地方是红色，较低的地方是蓝色。

sentences.en: And as she scrolls towards the terrace, the map gets very blue.
sentences.zh: 当她滚动地图看向特勒斯社区时，地图变得非常蓝。

sentences.en: It is sort of the low spot of a low spot, if you would.
sentences.zh: 可以说，这里是低洼地中的低洼地。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: So, that water is all rolling off and draining towards that neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有的水都在汇集并排向那个社区。

sentences.en: Jennifer says that when the neighborhood was first developed, this was less of a problem,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说，当这个社区最初开发时，这并不是什么大问题，

sentences.en: because it was surrounded by a lot of empty fields that could absorb runoff during a rainstorm.
sentences.zh: 因为它被许多空地包围着，这些空地可以在暴雨期间吸收径流。

sentences.en: But in the 80s and 90s, Lake Charles sprawled outward and enveloped the terrace,
sentences.zh: 但在80和90年代，查尔斯湖向外扩张并吞没了特勒斯社区，

sentences.en: encircling the neighborhood in big box stores, parking lots, and the 210 Highway.
sentences.zh: 用大型仓储式商店、停车场和210号公路包围了该社区。

sentences.en: And so now, when you get a lot of rain in a short period of time,
sentences.zh: 所以现在，当短时间内出现大量降雨时，

sentences.en: the water runs off all that pavement and heads straight for the low spot on the map.
sentences.zh: 水会从所有这些路面上流过，直奔地图上的低洼处。

sentences.en: There are a series of pumps that are supposed to help relieve pressure on the system,
sentences.zh: 有一系列泵站本应帮助减轻系统的压力，

sentences.en: but Jennifer says they just haven't been able to handle some of these storMs.
sentences.zh: 但詹妮弗说，它们根本无法应对其中一些风暴。

sentences.en: It can only pump so much so fast, and at the rate of rainfall, it just can't keep up,
sentences.zh: 它的抽水速度有限，面对这样的降雨量，它根本跟不上，

sentences.en: and that's when flooding happens.
sentences.zh: 这就是洪水发生的时候。

sentences.en: I asked Jennifer to try and sum up what exactly went wrong during these floods in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 我请詹妮弗试着总结一下特勒斯社区在这些洪水中到底出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And she said it was a wicked combination of factors.
sentences.zh: 她说这是一系列因素共同造成的恶果。

sentences.en: Extreme rainfall, a low-lying community surrounded by asphalt,
sentences.zh: 极端降雨、被沥青包围的低洼社区，

sentences.en: an aging drainage infrastructure that just wasn't designed to cope with this amount of water.
sentences.zh: 以及老化的排水基础设施，它们的设计初衷根本无法应对如此巨大的水量。

sentences.en: It's sort of a lot of little things that add up to be a big thing.
sentences.zh: 这就像是许多小问题累积成了一个大问题。

sentences.en: It may have been true that the terrace was facing a series of interlocking problems
sentences.zh: 特勒斯社区面临一系列相互关联的问题，这或许是真的，

sentences.en: that didn't have any easy solutions.
sentences.zh: 而且这些问题并没有简单的解决方案。

sentences.en: But that wasn't a very satisfying explanation for people who were actually living there.
sentences.zh: 但对于真正住在那里的居民来说，这并不是一个令人满意的解释。

sentences.en: And here's where the second narrative comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是第二种叙事出现的地方。

sentences.en: A lot of residents of the terrace felt like the government just hadn't done enough to protect them.
sentences.zh: 特勒斯社区的许多居民觉得政府在保护他们方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: There was a lot of skepticism about those pumps,
sentences.zh: 人们对那些泵站有很多怀疑，

sentences.en: and whether they had even been turned on during that crazy series of storMs.
sentences.zh: 怀疑在那一系列疯狂的风暴期间，它们是否真的被开启了。

sentences.en: And when Tramika Rankins kept hearing city and parish officials saying
sentences.zh: 当特拉米卡·兰金斯不断听到市和堂区官员说

sentences.en: that there wasn't much they could do about these unprecedented 100-year floods,
sentences.zh: 对于这些史无前例的百年一遇洪水，他们无能为力时，

sentences.en: it started to drive her crazy.
sentences.zh: 她开始感到抓狂。

sentences.en: How you gonna keep telling me it's a freaking 100-year flood?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么能一直跟我说这是百年一遇的洪水？

sentences.en: Well, God dang it.
sentences.zh: 该死。

sentences.en: We in the last days because 100 years coming every six months.
sentences.zh: 我们是不是到了末日，因为每六个月就来一次百年一遇的洪水。

sentences.en: Straight up.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: Like, don't get some of my intelligence.
sentences.zh: 别把我的智商当摆设。

sentences.en: It's called you guys' infrastructure is horrible.
sentences.zh: 这叫你们的基础设施太烂了。

sentences.en: And Tramika's bigger problem is that not all of the infrastructure in Lake Charles is horrible.
sentences.zh: 特拉米卡更大的问题在于，查尔斯湖并非所有的基础设施都很烂。

sentences.en: If you go to a newer, wealthier, often whiter neighborhood that was built to more recent standards,
sentences.zh: 如果你去一个较新的、更富裕的、通常白人更多的社区，那里是按照较新的标准建造的，

sentences.en: you'll see a drain at the end of every driveway.
sentences.zh: 你会看到每个车道尽头都有排水口。

sentences.en: But that's just not the case in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 但这在特勒斯社区根本不是这样。

sentences.en: I'm just saying that you did not invest in any kind of infrastructure or drainage structure here in the area
sentences.zh: 我只是说，你们没有在这个地区的任何基础设施或排水结构上进行投资，

sentences.en: that could have maybe offset this.
sentences.zh: 本来是可以抵消这种情况的。

sentences.en: That's what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 我就是这个意思。

sentences.en: What I'm saying is you have maliciously avoided to even help this area.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们恶意地避开了对这个地区的任何帮助。

sentences.en: The flooding was new, but for Tramika and for many other residents of the terrace,
sentences.zh: 洪水是新的，但对于特拉米卡和特勒斯社区的许多其他居民来说，

sentences.en: it also felt like the latest chapter in a much larger story.
sentences.zh: 这感觉也像是一个更大故事的最新篇章。

sentences.en: A story about how there were no longer any grocery stores in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 一个关于社区里不再有杂货店的故事。

sentences.en: How the local bank closed down and the Walgreens moved away.
sentences.zh: 关于当地银行倒闭、沃尔格林搬走的故事。

sentences.en: Climate impacts don't happen in isolation.
sentences.zh: 气候影响并非孤立发生。

sentences.en: The climate is changing on top of a pre-existing infrastructure of inequality.
sentences.zh: 气候变化是叠加在既有的不平等基础设施之上的。

sentences.en: And so when Tramika heard government officials blaming the floods on these unprecedented storms and climate change,
sentences.zh: 所以当特拉米卡听到政府官员将洪水归咎于这些前所未有的风暴和气候变化时，

sentences.en: it almost felt like a convenient excuse.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是一个方便的借口。

sentences.en: A way to avoid accountability for failing to invest in her community.
sentences.zh: 一种逃避因未能投资她的社区而应承担的责任的方式。

sentences.en: It's a combination of climate change.
sentences.zh: 这是气候变化的综合结果。

sentences.en: I'm not saying that that does not play a fact in it.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说那没有影响。

sentences.en: But what you allocating your dollars to care for and do has a lot to do with what's happened here.
sentences.zh: 但你们把资金分配到哪里去维护和建设，与这里发生的事情有很大关系。

sentences.en: Tramika started calling the city, demanding that something be done to fix the drainage problem.
sentences.zh: 特拉米卡开始给市政府打电话，要求采取措施解决排水问题。

sentences.en: Enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 受够了，真的受够了。

sentences.en: How do you expect somebody to stay sane and you keep doing the same thing so it's over and over
sentences.zh: 你怎么能指望一个人保持理智，而你们却一遍又一遍地做同样的事情，

sentences.en: and you don't expect somebody to rise up and say anything about it?
sentences.zh: 还不指望有人站出来说点什么？

sentences.en: She kept calling and calling.
sentences.zh: 她不停地打，一直打。

sentences.en: She even got in touch with the mayor and told him that he needed to do more to protect the terrorists.
sentences.zh: 她甚至联系了市长，告诉他必须采取更多措施来保护特勒斯社区。

sentences.en: But she also made extra sure to protect herself.
sentences.zh: 但她也格外注意保护自己。

sentences.en: She got flood insurance for real this time.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她真的买了洪水保险。

sentences.en: Her new policy kicked in on May 16th, 2021.
sentences.zh: 她的新保单于2021年5月16日生效。

sentences.en: And I kid you not, just one day after it went into effect,
sentences.zh: 我没骗你，就在生效后的第二天，

sentences.en: Lake Charles got hit with one of the largest rainstorms in the city's history.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯湖就遭遇了该市历史上最大的暴雨之一。

sentences.en: My insurance kicked in May 16th and May 17th was a flood.
sentences.zh: 我的保险5月16日生效，5月17日就发洪水了。

sentences.en: Over a foot of rain fell on Lake Charles in less than a day.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯湖在不到一天的时间里降雨量超过了一英尺。

sentences.en: The storm was totally unexpected and so there was no time to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴完全出乎意料，所以根本没有时间撤离。

sentences.en: Tramika and her son were actually in their house when water started spilling out of the coulee.
sentences.zh: 特拉米卡和她儿子当时正在屋里，水就开始从沟渠里溢出来了。

sentences.en: She knew this could get ugly and so she started running around unplugging TVs and appliances
sentences.zh: 她知道情况会变得很糟，于是开始到处拔掉电视和电器的插头，

sentences.en: and just trying to get their most valuable possessions off the ground.
sentences.zh: 只想把他们最值钱的东西搬离地面。

sentences.en: Her son was looking at her like, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 她儿子看着她，心想，你在干什么？

sentences.en: He's like, what's wrong, mama?
sentences.zh: 他问，怎么了，妈妈？

sentences.en: I'm like, the water's coming.
sentences.zh: 我说，水要来了。

sentences.en: I don't know when it's coming, but it's coming.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它什么时候来，但它肯定会来。

sentences.en: And then she heard the sound of her son's car in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 然后她听到了儿子车子在车道上的声音。

sentences.en: I heard my son's car.
sentences.zh: 我听到了我儿子的车。

sentences.en: I'll never forget it was like, beep, beep, beep.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记，那是，哔，哔，哔的声音。

sentences.en: The car died, submerged in flood water.
sentences.zh: 车子熄火了，淹没在洪水里。

sentences.en: And then the water was inside the house.
sentences.zh: 然后水就进了屋子。

sentences.en: I said, the water's here.
sentences.zh: 我说，水来了。

sentences.en: And I looked out my window.
sentences.zh: 我看向窗外。

sentences.en: And I felt like the people would have felt in the Titanic.
sentences.zh: 我感觉就像泰坦尼克号上的人们一样。

sentences.en: And the water came in so fast and so vigorous that it knocked the shoes off my feet and it made me fall into the water.
sentences.zh: 水涌进来得如此之快、如此猛烈，以至于把我的鞋子都冲掉了，让我跌进了水里。

sentences.en: And I'm six foot something, as you can tell.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我个子很高。

sentences.en: The water was over my waiSt.
sentences.zh: 水已经没过我的腰了。

sentences.en: Tremika climbed onto the back of the couch and, in the middle of this drenched chaos, called her insurance agent just to double check that her new policy,
sentences.zh: 特拉米卡爬上沙发背，在这片被淹没的混乱中，给她的保险代理人打电话，只是为了确认她的新保单，

sentences.en: that one that was supposed to kick in the day before, was definitely active.
sentences.zh: 就是前一天刚生效的那份，是否确实有效。

sentences.en: I said, my house is filling with water.
sentences.zh: 我说，我的房子正在进水。

sentences.en: She said, there's no freaking way.
sentences.zh: 她说，这不可能。

sentences.en: I've never had anyone call me within 20, not even 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 我从来没遇到过有人在20小时，甚至不到24小时内就给我打电话的。

sentences.en: And the, are you serious?
sentences.zh: 然后，你是认真的吗？

sentences.en: I said, yes, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，女士。

sentences.en: I said, I can show you pictures.
sentences.zh: 我说，我可以给你看照片。

sentences.en: I'm showing a picture of the water.
sentences.zh: 我展示了一张水的照片。

sentences.en: She's like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 她说，天哪。

sentences.en: The May 17th storm was a turning point for Tremika.
sentences.zh: 5月17日的风暴是特拉米卡的转折点。

sentences.en: May 17th literally changed my life.
sentences.zh: 5月17日彻底改变了我的生活。

sentences.en: That changed the way that I saw things because I was like a mental snap.
sentences.zh: 那改变了我看待事物的方式，因为我当时精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: There's no way I'm going to live in this house any much longer.
sentences.zh: 我不可能再在这个房子里住下去了。

sentences.en: Like, I just can't make it make sense anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法说服自己留在这里了。

sentences.en: If the government wasn't going to improve the drainage situation, Tremika didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 如果政府不打算改善排水状况，特拉米卡不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: She didn't feel like she could justify rebuilding her house again in what had clearly become a dangerous location.
sentences.zh: 她觉得无法证明在这样一个显然已经变得危险的地方再次重建房子是合理的。

sentences.en: She needed help.
sentences.zh: 她需要帮助。

sentences.en: Coming up after the break, help arrives.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，帮助即将到来。

sentences.en: But it's not what Tremika was looking for.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是特拉米卡所期待的。

sentences.en: When we left off, Tremika Rankins was demanding solutions to the terraces' flooding probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们上次说到，特拉米卡·兰金斯要求解决特勒斯社区的洪水问题。

sentences.en: And it turns out that someone was trying to figure out a solution.
sentences.zh: 结果有人正在试图寻找解决方案。

sentences.en: A man named Pat Forbes.
sentences.zh: 一个叫帕特·福布斯的人。

sentences.en: I'm Pat Forbes.
sentences.zh: 我是帕特·福布斯。

sentences.en: I'm the executive director of the Louisiana Office of Community Development.
sentences.zh: 我是路易斯安那州社区发展办公室的执行主任。

sentences.en: Pat heads up a statewide program called the Watershed Initiative, which tries to make Louisiana more resilient to the floods of the future.
sentences.zh: 帕特负责一个名为“流域倡议”的全州项目，旨在提高路易斯安那州应对未来洪水的韧性。

sentences.en: Rainstorms are going to be more intense and more frequent.
sentences.zh: 暴雨将会变得更加强烈和频繁。

sentences.en: And so, consequently, what we think we know about where the risk begins and ends from flooding is probably out the window.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们认为自己所了解的洪水风险的起点和终点，可能都已经过时了。

sentences.en: Traditionally, the government has managed flooding mostly with hard infrastructure and technology.
sentences.zh: 传统上，政府主要通过硬基础设施和技术来管理洪水。

sentences.en: Things like pumps and levees.
sentences.zh: 比如泵站和堤坝之类的东西。

sentences.en: But as flood risk increases because of climate change, people like Pat are starting to come around to a different strategy.
sentences.zh: 但随着气候变化导致洪水风险增加，像帕特这样的人开始转向一种不同的策略。

sentences.en: It's called managed retreat.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“受控撤退”。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't hate the idea.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我不反感这个想法。

sentences.en: Managed retreat is much more efficient than chaotic retreat.
sentences.zh: 有计划的撤离远比混乱的撤离要高效得多。

sentences.en: And it's a lot less disruptive to people's lives.
sentences.zh: 而且对人们生活的干扰也小得多。

sentences.en: The idea is that with so many looming climate threats, it just isn't possible to protect every place with infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是，面对如此多迫在眉睫的气候威胁，仅靠基础设施来保护每一个地方是不可能的。

sentences.en: Things like bigger levees or better drainage.
sentences.zh: 比如修建更大的堤坝或改善排水系统。

sentences.en: We can't hold the line and defend every piece of property against rising seas and supercharged storMs.
sentences.zh: 我们无法守住防线，去抵御海平面上升和超强风暴对每一处房产的侵袭。

sentences.en: And so, in particularly risky places, the safest, most resilient option might be to try and get everyone out of harm's way.
sentences.zh: 因此，在风险极高的地方，最安全、最具韧性的选择或许就是设法让所有人远离危险。

sentences.en: There's not enough money in the world for us to build our way out of flood risk.
sentences.zh: 世界上没有足够的资金让我们通过大兴土木来彻底摆脱洪水风险。

sentences.en: We're going to have to start getting out of the way where we never should have gotten in the way in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我们必须开始撤离那些本就不该涉足的危险地带。

sentences.en: Managed retreat is not a totally new idea.
sentences.zh: 有计划的撤离并不是一个全新的概念。

sentences.en: There's a famous example where the town of Valmire, Illinois, moved away from the Mississippi River and on to higher ground after the big flood of 1993.
sentences.zh: 有一个著名的例子：1993年大洪水过后，伊利诺伊州的瓦尔迈尔镇从密西西比河畔搬迁到了地势更高的地方。

sentences.en: And Pat has actually moved several flood-prone towns or neighborhoods in Louisiana,
sentences.zh: 帕特实际上已经在路易斯安那州搬迁了几个易受洪水侵袭的城镇或社区，

sentences.en: including a couple where they have built a whole new community for everyone to move to together.
sentences.zh: 其中包括几个为所有人共同搬迁而新建了整个社区的案例。

sentences.en: And so they remain neighbors.
sentences.zh: 这样他们依然是邻居。

sentences.en: Instead of having that be a diaspora, have them go live together somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 与其让他们四散而去，不如让他们搬到同一个地方共同生活。

sentences.en: But building an entire new neighborhood is really, really expensive.
sentences.zh: 但建设一个全新的社区真的非常、非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And so often, they'll use a different tool to try and get people to safety.
sentences.zh: 所以通常情况下，他们会使用另一种工具来设法保障人们的安全。

sentences.en: The buyout.
sentences.zh: 那就是收购。

sentences.en: In a buyout, the government just pays people for their flood-prone homes and lets them choose where they want to move.
sentences.zh: 在收购计划中，政府直接出资买下人们易受洪水侵袭的房屋，并让他们自行选择搬迁地点。

sentences.en: Then,
sentences.zh: 然后，

sentences.en: they'd demolish the old houses and ideally convert the land back into a wetland or a reservoir or something that can store water during a storm and help reduce flooding throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 他们会拆除旧房，理想情况下将土地恢复为湿地、水库或某种能在风暴期间蓄水并帮助减轻全市洪涝灾害的设施。

sentences.en: I mean, there can be parks and things like that that flood when it floods, but there won't be people's houses.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可以修建一些在洪水期间会被淹没的公园之类的设施，但不会再有居民的房屋。

sentences.en: For Pat, this is an equity issue.
sentences.zh: 对帕特来说，这是一个公平问题。

sentences.en: Because while flooding certainly affects wealthy people with homes along the beach, it's actually a much more common problem for working-class communities and communities of color.
sentences.zh: 因为虽然洪水确实会影响海边拥有房产的富人，但这实际上是工薪阶层社区和有色人种社区面临的更普遍的问题。

sentences.en: There are a lot of reasons why that's the case.
sentences.zh: 造成这种情况的原因有很多。

sentences.en: Sometimes racist housing policies like redlining pushed people onto flood-prone land.
sentences.zh: 有时，像“红线政策”这种种族主义住房政策将人们推向了易受洪水侵袭的土地。

sentences.en: Sometimes the government has just failed to maintain the infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 有时，政府只是未能维护好基础设施。

sentences.en: And often, the lowest-lying land is just cheaper.
sentences.zh: 而且通常情况下，地势最低的土地价格也更便宜。

sentences.en: Pat sees buyouts as an effort to address the mistakes of the past, the development decisions and housing policies that put a lot of marginalized people at risk.
sentences.zh: 帕特将收购视为一种纠正过去错误、弥补那些让许多边缘化群体陷入风险的开发决策和住房政策的努力。

sentences.en: A lot of people have paid a very steep price for development in floodplains.
sentences.zh: 许多人为在洪泛区进行开发付出了极其惨痛的代价。

sentences.en: They've essentially had their opportunity for building generational wealth stolen from them because their house is actually depreciated instead of appreciating.
sentences.zh: 他们的房屋实际上是在贬值而不是升值，这从根本上剥夺了他们积累代际财富的机会。

sentences.en: Pat talks about the buyout like a ladder out of a money pit.
sentences.zh: 帕特把收购比作从金钱陷阱中爬出来的梯子。

sentences.en: Our funds are focused on helping the most vulnerable people in the communities.
sentences.zh: 我们的资金专注于帮助社区中最脆弱的人群。

sentences.en: We don't go do buyouts for affluent folks, right, on the beach or something.
sentences.zh: 我们不会去为富人做收购，比如海滩上的那些人，对吧。

sentences.en: Those aren't our targets.
sentences.zh: 那些不是我们的目标对象。

sentences.en: It's the people who have been shortchanged in the past and need an opportunity for a restart.
sentences.zh: 我们需要帮助的是那些过去被亏待、需要重新开始机会的人。

sentences.en: Pat heard about the flooding in Greenwich Terrace from a local official and sent people to check out the area.
sentences.zh: 帕特从当地官员那里听说了格林威治露台区的洪水情况，并派人去实地考察。

sentences.en: And then when that final May flood happened, it was like, okay, this neighborhood meets all the criteria.
sentences.zh: 当五月份那场最终的洪水发生时，情况就是：好吧，这个社区符合所有标准。

sentences.en: And then that's when we set about setting up a buyout program for Greenwich Terrace.
sentences.zh: 于是我们着手为格林威治露台区制定收购计划。

sentences.en: The Watershed Initiative allocated $30 million to buy out the most vulnerable homes in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 流域倡议组织拨款3000万美元，用于收购露台区最脆弱的房屋。

sentences.en: But for a lot of the people actually living in the terrace, the buyout raised this question.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多真正住在露台区的人来说，收购引发了这样一个问题。

sentences.en: If you've got $30 million to help us out, why not just use that money to fix the drainage?
sentences.zh: 既然你们有3000万美元来帮助我们，为什么不直接用这笔钱来修复排水系统呢？

sentences.en: You know, we could have just fixed the flooding situation and plumbed it with all the money that they spent.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们花掉的那些钱本可以用来解决洪水问题并铺设好管道。

sentences.en: To buy the homes and then tear them down, you could have just invested the money into the plumbing.
sentences.zh: 与其买下房屋再拆掉，本可以将资金投入到管道工程中。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: To the drainage.
sentences.zh: 投入到排水系统中。

sentences.en: This is a man I met who still lives in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 这是我遇到的一位仍然住在露台区的男士。

sentences.en: He didn't want to give his name, but he had a lot to say about the buyout program.
sentences.zh: 他不想透露姓名，但对收购计划有很多话要说。

sentences.en: He lives just outside the zone of houses that are eligible, so he wasn't offered a buyout.
sentences.zh: 他住在符合收购条件的房屋区域之外，所以他没有收到收购提议。

sentences.en: But he wishes that money could have been spent on a solution that would have allowed everyone to stay.
sentences.zh: 但他希望那笔钱能花在一种能让所有人留下的解决方案上。

sentences.en: You know, as you can see here, we need a drain here on this street.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如你在这里看到的，我们需要在这条街上修一个排水沟。

sentences.en: That way the water would drain.
sentences.zh: 这样水就能排走了。

sentences.en: Are you worried about more flooding?
sentences.zh: 你担心会发生更多的洪水吗？

sentences.en: I worry about flooding every day when it rains.
sentences.zh: 我每天下雨时都担心洪水。

sentences.en: You know, that's something we worry about in the area every day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是我们该地区每天都在担心的事情。

sentences.en: You know, it's not just flooding here in the Greenwich Terrace.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不仅仅是格林威治露台区有洪水。

sentences.en: It's flooding in other areas in the city.
sentences.zh: 城市里的其他区域也在发洪水。

sentences.en: But I really believe that to correct the problem is to correct the drainage.
sentences.zh: 但我真的相信，解决问题的办法就是改善排水系统。

sentences.en: Fix the drainage firSt.
sentences.zh: 先修好排水系统。

sentences.en: Then you'll fix the problem.
sentences.zh: 问题自然就解决了。

sentences.en: Many people I talked to expressed similar feelings.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的许多人都表达了类似的感受。

sentences.en: And it's really no surprise that fixing the drainage would be a more popular option than a buyout.
sentences.zh: 修复排水系统比收购更受欢迎，这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: People are always going to prefer a solution that allows them to remain in a community that they love.
sentences.zh: 人们总是更倾向于选择一种能让他们留在自己热爱的社区里的解决方案。

sentences.en: Recurring feeling that I feel like a lot of people have of, like, we could have used that money differently.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到很多人都有这种反复出现的想法，即我们本可以以不同的方式使用那笔钱。

sentences.en: You know, $30 million.
sentences.zh: 你知道，3000万美元。

sentences.en: Why wasn't that money used to protect this neighborhood in some way?
sentences.zh: 为什么那笔钱没有被用来以某种方式保护这个社区呢？

sentences.en: I put this question to Jennifer Kobian, the grants director for Calcasieu Parish.
sentences.zh: 我把这个问题提给了卡尔克苏教区的拨款主管詹妮弗·科比安。

sentences.en: What do you say to that?
sentences.zh: 对此你怎么看？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that decision was made at the state level and was sort of offered to the community to participate in the buyout program.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，那个决定是在州一级做出的，并向社区提供了参与收购计划的机会。

sentences.en: We did not have an offer on the table to do a drainage improvement project.
sentences.zh: 我们当时并没有收到进行排水改善项目的提议。

sentences.en: So we didn't have a choice between a drainage improvement project or a buyout.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有在排水改善项目和收购之间做选择的余地。

sentences.en: We only had the buyout on the table.
sentences.zh: 我们当时只有收购这一个选项。

sentences.en: Jennifer says that the parish is trying to get grants to improve the capacity of the pumps in that area.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说，教区正在努力争取拨款，以提高该地区泵站的排水能力。

sentences.en: But she's not sure how much they can lower the overall risk.
sentences.zh: 但她不确定这能在多大程度上降低整体风险。

sentences.en: Drainage improvement will have some improvement to the area, but it will not eliminate the flood risk just given the low topography of the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 排水改善会对该地区有所帮助，但考虑到该社区地势低洼，它无法消除洪水风险。

sentences.en: They're low.
sentences.zh: 它们地势很低。

sentences.en: Those houses are sitting really low.
sentences.zh: 那些房子坐落的位置真的很低。

sentences.en: So, like, if a house was built there today, they'd have to build four feet higher than where they're at right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果今天要在那里盖房子，他们必须比现在的位置高出四英尺。

sentences.en: Jennifer said that buyouts should always be the last option.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说，收购应该永远是最后的选择。

sentences.en: But there just wasn't a great alternative.
sentences.zh: 但当时确实没有更好的替代方案。

sentences.en: And when the state called offering money, it wasn't something she felt she could afford to turn down.
sentences.zh: 当州政府打电话提供资金时，她觉得无法拒绝。

sentences.en: It seemed like the best way to get people help as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是尽快为人们提供帮助的最佳途径。

sentences.en: It may well be true that there wasn't a viable way to fix the drainage situation in the terrace.
sentences.zh: 或许确实没有切实可行的方法来解决露台区的排水问题。

sentences.en: But I think this situation raises an important question about climate adaptation.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这种情况提出了一个关于气候适应的重要问题。

sentences.en: Who is being offered solutions that allow them to remain in place?
sentences.zh: 谁能获得让他们留下的解决方案？

sentences.en: And who is being asked to move?
sentences.zh: 而谁又被要求搬迁？

sentences.en: A lot of this is driven by economics.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上是由经济因素驱动的。

sentences.en: This is Anna Weber, a senior policy analyst with the NRDC.
sentences.zh: 这是自然资源保护委员会（NRDC）的高级政策分析师安娜·韦伯。

sentences.en: She says that a lot of decisions about whether or not to build new protective infrastructure, things like seawalls or new pumps, are determined in part by how much, quote,
sentences.zh: 她说，关于是否建设新的防护基础设施（如海堤或新泵站）的许多决定，部分取决于该项目能保护多少，引用，

sentences.en: value the project can protect.
sentences.zh: “价值”。

sentences.en: It is more, quote unquote, worth it to protect areas of higher value in a financial sense.
sentences.zh: 从经济意义上讲，保护高价值地区更“值得”。

sentences.en: And that means that on the flip side, areas of, quote unquote, lower value in a financial sense are often left out.
sentences.zh: 这意味着反过来说，经济意义上“价值较低”的地区往往会被排除在外。

sentences.en: They're not put behind the wall.
sentences.zh: 他们不会被置于防洪墙之后。

sentences.en: They're not protected by the structural projects.
sentences.zh: 他们不会受到结构性工程的保护。

sentences.en: And they are more likely to get offered a buyout.
sentences.zh: 他们更有可能被提议进行收购。

sentences.en: I want to just pause for a second because I think there is a genuine conundrum here.
sentences.zh: 我想暂停一下，因为我认为这里存在一个真正的难题。

sentences.en: On the one hand, a buyout is a government benefit.
sentences.zh: 一方面，收购是一种政府福利。

sentences.en: And so, of course, you want to give that benefit to the people who need it the moSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，你想把这种福利给予最需要它的人。

sentences.en: Communities of color, lower income communities are much more likely to be faced with the impacts of chronic flooding.
sentences.zh: 有色人种社区和低收入社区更有可能面临长期洪水的冲击。

sentences.en: And so when buyouts are proposed, it makes sense that these communities might be at the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，当提出收购建议时，这些社区出现在名单前列是有道理的。

sentences.en: They're the ones facing the risks.
sentences.zh: 他们是面临风险的人。

sentences.en: They're the ones who should get the first chance to relocate.
sentences.zh: 他们应该是第一批获得搬迁机会的人。

sentences.en: That makes sense, logically, right?
sentences.zh: 从逻辑上讲，这说得通，对吧？

sentences.en: But a buyout is a weird kind of benefit.
sentences.zh: 但收购是一种奇怪的福利。

sentences.en: The kind of benefit that destroys a neighborhood and displaces everyone within it.
sentences.zh: 这种福利会摧毁一个社区，并使其中的每个人流离失所。

sentences.en: And so if you're focusing on giving buyouts to working class communities of color.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你专注于向工薪阶层的有色人种社区提供收购，

sentences.en: It also means that these communities are effectively being targeted, not in a malicious way, but they are being prioritized for relocation.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着这些社区实际上成为了目标，并非出于恶意，但他们被优先考虑进行搬迁。

sentences.en: And that has additional effects.
sentences.zh: 而这会产生额外的影响。

sentences.en: These are communities that have contributed the least to the problem.
sentences.zh: 这些社区对问题的贡献最小。

sentences.en: These are communities that are facing accumulative impacts, probably of lots of other kinds of challenges.
sentences.zh: 这些社区正面临着累积的影响，可能还有许多其他类型的挑战。

sentences.en: Environmental pollution, disinvestment in infrastructure, and now they're being told to relocate.
sentences.zh: 环境污染、基础设施投资不足，现在又被告知要搬迁。

sentences.en: That's a huge problem from a justice standpoint.
sentences.zh: 从正义的角度来看，这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Anna is in a funny place when it comes to buyouts.
sentences.zh: 在收购问题上，安娜处于一个尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: In many ways, she's one of their chief critics.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，她是主要的批评者之一。

sentences.en: I like to clarify when I talk to people about home buyouts.
sentences.zh: 当我和人们谈论房屋收购时，我喜欢澄清一点。

sentences.en: I'm not advocating for buyouts.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在倡导收购。

sentences.en: People are taking a buyout because it's their last option.
sentences.zh: 人们接受收购是因为这是他们最后的选择。

sentences.en: It's their last least bad option.
sentences.zh: 这是他们最后、最无奈的选择。

sentences.en: The rest of the people there are waiting to see if more funding becomes available.
sentences.zh: 其余的人正在等待看是否有更多的资金可用。

sentences.en: They're also waiting to see what happens with the empty land.
sentences.zh: 他们也在等待看空地会发生什么。

sentences.en: Jennifer Cobian wants to build a park back there that could hold water during a storm.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·科比安想在那里建一个公园，可以在暴风雨期间蓄水。

sentences.en: Tramika would like to see something like that.
sentences.zh: 特拉梅卡也想看到类似的东西。

sentences.en: She would like to know that by moving, she helped make the neighborhood safer for the people
sentences.zh: 她想知道，通过搬家，她帮助让留下来的人的社区变得更安全了。

sentences.en: who remain.
sentences.zh: 留下来的人的社区变得更安全了。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever visited a city or a neighborhood that you've lived in before
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否曾经去过你以前住过的城市或社区，

sentences.en: and felt the urge to go drive by your old house.
sentences.zh: 并产生过开车经过你旧房子的冲动。

sentences.en: If you've glanced in the window and seen someone else's life just carrying on inside this space
sentences.zh: 如果你瞥了一眼窗户，看到别人的生活在那个仍然感觉像是你的空间里继续进行，

sentences.en: that still kind of feels like yours.
sentences.zh: 那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: For Tramika, there was actually no one living in her old house.
sentences.zh: 对特拉梅卡来说，她的旧房子里其实没有人住。

sentences.en: It belonged to the state.
sentences.zh: 它属于州政府。

sentences.en: But she still felt that pull.
sentences.zh: 但她仍然感到那种牵引力。

sentences.en: She found herself driving by the terrace on the way home from work,
sentences.zh: 她发现自己下班回家的路上会开车经过露台，

sentences.en: even though it wasn't on her route.
sentences.zh: 尽管那不在她的路线上。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know what's drawing me there, but I found myself going out in front of the house
sentences.zh: 就像，我不知道是什么吸引我到那里，但我发现自己会去房子前面，

sentences.en: and I found myself doing that once or twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己每周会去一两次。

sentences.en: And then one day, she drove by the old house
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，她开车经过旧房子，

sentences.en: and there was a backhoe punching holes in the roof.
sentences.zh: 看到一辆挖掘机正在屋顶上凿洞。

sentences.en: And I sat there.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那里。

sentences.en: It took them all 15 minutes to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们总共花了15分钟就完成了。

sentences.en: 15, 20, maybe 25 minutes.
And I cried.
sentences.zh: 我哭了。

sentences.en: It's wild that you just happened to be there that day.
sentences.zh: 你那天刚好在那里，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I was just like, jump out on it because I wasn't expecting that.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像，跳出来看，因为我没预料到会发生那种事。

sentences.en: She knew that the house would be demolished soon,
sentences.zh: 她知道房子很快就会被拆除，

sentences.en: but she had no idea it was going to happen while she was sitting right there in her car.
sentences.zh: 但她没想到这一切竟然就在她坐在车里时发生了。

sentences.en: She pulled out her phone and took a video of this bizarre scene to send to her husband.
sentences.zh: 她掏出手机拍下了这诡异的一幕，发给了她丈夫。

sentences.en: The little house where they spent decades of their life getting torn apart board by board.
sentences.zh: 他们生活了几十年的小房子，就这样被一块一块地拆除了。

sentences.en: I just happened to roll up on this today.
sentences.zh: 我今天刚好开车路过这里。

sentences.en: I really don't know how I feel about this.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该作何感想。

sentences.en: I really don't know how I feel about this, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，我真的不知道该作何感想。

sentences.en: Even though Tramika was sure that taking the buyout was the right financial decision,
sentences.zh: 尽管特拉米卡（Tramika）确信接受买断方案是正确的财务决定，

sentences.en: you can hear the ambivalence in her voice.
sentences.zh: 但你依然能从她的声音中听出那种矛盾感。

sentences.en: And honestly, I don't know how I feel about it either.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我也不知道自己该作何感想。

sentences.en: When I left Tramika, I drove back to my hotel over the Calcasieu River Bridge,
sentences.zh: 离开特拉米卡后，我开车经过卡尔克苏河大桥（Calcasieu River Bridge）回到酒店，

sentences.en: past the glittering lights of the petrochemical plants reflecting off the water.
sentences.zh: 路过石化工厂在水面上映出的闪烁灯光。

sentences.en: And in that moment, I honestly felt overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我感到无比沉重。

sentences.en: At the thought of just how many people will need to endure some version
sentences.zh: 想到未来还有多少人需要经历某种形式的、

sentences.en: of the brutally stressful, bittersweet process that Tramika went through.
sentences.zh: 像特拉米卡所经历的那样残酷、痛苦且苦乐参半的过程。

sentences.en: How many people will have to move away from a home that they weren't ready to leave?
sentences.zh: 有多少人将不得不离开他们本不想离开的家？

sentences.en: From a kitchen they painted themselves, with the heights of children penciled on the wall.
sentences.zh: 离开他们亲手粉刷的厨房，墙上还留着孩子们身高的刻痕。

sentences.en: There's no policy fix for that.
sentences.zh: 对此，没有任何政策能解决问题。

sentences.en: Coming up next week on Not Built For This,
sentences.zh: 下周的《Not Built For This》节目中，

sentences.en: we have an unlikely story of a community that didn't need to move.
sentences.zh: 我们将讲述一个意想不到的故事：一个本不必搬迁的社区。

sentences.en: A town that actually got the protective infrastructure it will need
sentences.zh: 一个真正获得了未来几年生存所需的、

sentences.en: to survive in the years to come.
sentences.zh: 防护基础设施的城镇。

sentences.en: And it only took them two decades, many trips to the Pentagon,
sentences.zh: 这花费了他们整整二十年，多次前往五角大楼，

sentences.en: and thousands of tamales.
sentences.zh: 以及数以千计的塔马利玉米粽。

sentences.en: When we went back to Washington, we were at the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 当我们回到华盛顿，来到五角大楼时。

sentences.en: The first thing that came out was,
sentences.zh: 他们开口问的第一件事就是，

sentences.en: you get any tamales?
sentences.zh: 你们带塔马利来了吗？

sentences.en: We did not bring your tamales to the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 我们没把塔马利带到五角大楼。

sentences.en: Sorry!
sentences.zh: 抱歉！

sentences.en: You know, that was the tamale diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是“塔马利外交”。
